execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (ratified -- see DR-005, issue #1)' rows 'Output reference' (1.20 V +/-2% untrimmed, 3sigma mismatch MC N>=300 + process corners, -40...125 degC) and 'Temp coefficient (-40...125 degC)' (< 50 ppm/degC), for the 3.3 V primary flavor (DR-001). Measures the ROUTED, LVS-clean bandgap-core layout (issue #62) open-circuit, untrimmed, via klt extract --parasitics translated to a simulatable netlist (sim/bin/post_layout_common.py) -- NOT design/bandgap_core.sch directly; see 'Netlist provenance' below.
experiment.provenance_source: layout/bandgap-core/reports/20260923-070209-dbd57a9/bandgap_core_routed.gds via `klt extract --parasitics` (layout record 20260923-070209-dbd57a9), translated by sim/bin/post_layout_common.py, wrapped over the unmodified sim/output-voltage-tc/testbench/tb_vref_tc.sch
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix claim, not a distribution claim -- untrimmed spread from local mismatch is issue #12's Monte Carlo)
experiment.title: Untrimmed output reference and box-method temperature coefficient over -40..125 degC -- POST-LAYOUT (extracted netlist)

matrix.subset_reason: Reuses sim/output-voltage-tc's own subset: the box-method TC needs the -40..125 degC excursion swept continuously INSIDE the deck (dc temp), so the runner's outer temperature axis is collapsed to one point on purpose. Process and supply axes run in full (5 x 3 = 15 points).

spread_checks.note: VREF(27 degC) must move by at least 0.1 mV across the process/supply matrix. A dead-flat result across 15 corner points means the corner include or the supply param is not reaching the simulator.

tools.ngspice: ngspice-47 (remote, batch fleet c7i.8xlarge; not the dispatch host's ngspice)
